services.title: From requirements to implementation and ongoing development
services.description: ONVORX can join a project at different stages — from defining requirements and building a new website to developing an existing solution and supporting further growth.

items.title: Web Development
items.text: Build a new website from ready designs and requirements, with structure and UX/UI support when needed.

items.title: Website Support & Development
items.text: Improve and extend an existing WordPress or Horoshop website with new pages, functionality, integrations and ongoing support.

items.title: Business Analysis
items.text: Clarify business processes, scope and requirements before automation or software development begins.

items.title: Google Ads
items.text: Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns as a separate channel for attracting relevant paid traffic.

howWork.title: A clear path from task to implementation
howWork.description: ONVORX can join a project at the stage where support is needed — from clarifying requirements to implementation and further development.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: We review the business context, available designs, current solution and requirements to define what needs to be implemented.

steps.title: Estimate
steps.text: We define the implementation scope, dependencies and approach needed to prepare a project estimate.

steps.title: Implement
steps.text: We develop the agreed solution, handle required integrations and test the implementation before launch.

steps.title: Support & Develop
steps.text: ONVORX can support the solution after launch, implement improvements and continue its further development.

about.title: Practical experience behind every project
about.description: ONVORX combines hands-on web development experience with a structured approach to requirements, implementation and ongoing development.

stats.title: Real project work
stats.text: Experience across WordPress, WooCommerce extensions and front-end implementation.

stats.title: Beyond implementation
stats.text: Requirements and business processes are the foundation before development begins.

cta.title: Let’s turn your requirements into a working solution
cta.description: Tell us what you’re planning, what already exists and where support is needed. ONVORX will review the requirements and clarify what’s needed to prepare a project estimate.
cta.note: Your information is secure and will not be shared.
